title_en: Spring 2026 Final Approved Thesis Submission (Preservation Copy) for Graduate Students
summary: Master's and doctoral students expected to graduate in Spring 2026 must submit their final approved thesis in two parts, and both parts must be completed. They must upload the thesis file and the separately signed approval page at dCollection (https://dcollection.snu.ac.kr) between 17 July and 3 August 2026, 23:59. They must also submit the printed Thesis Submission Confirmation Form and the original approval page to the department office (Building 301, Room 319) between 20 July and 24 July 2026, 17:00. Students who do not submit the confirmation form and approval page will be excluded from degree conferral.
applies_to: Mandatory for all master's and doctoral students in the department who are expected to graduate in Spring 2026 (2026학년도 1학기). This includes students graduating this semester who did not submit the preservation thesis last semester and doctoral students who applied for an extension of the review period.

conditions: Submission is complete only when both the department office submission and the online submission are finished.
Students who do not submit the Thesis Submission Confirmation Form and the approval page will be excluded from degree conferral.
The confirmation form cannot be printed if you have unreturned library books or unpaid overdue fines.
The approval page may be signed or sealed.

If any committee member's signature is a copy (for example an online signature), you must submit evidence of that member's approval, such as the full printed email exchange, for every such member; without this evidence, a handwritten signature or seal is required.
After 3 August 2026, 23:59, no correction, replacement or time extension is possible, for any reason, including late signatures or health reasons.
Only one full-text PDF file may be uploaded, under 100 MB in total; the signed approval page must be uploaded as a separate file.
No bound copy is submitted to the department office; the preservation thesis is submitted to the library online only.
You must give consent to the use of the full text of your thesis.
The thesis title must be identical in MySNU, on the approval page, in the uploaded file and in the library record; if your title changed, you must inform the department office.
The title may differ from the title on the thesis review result documents.
The submission date and approval date on the approval page must fall within this semester, and the approval date must be after the submission date; using the same date for both is recommended.
Master's committee: chair, vice-chair (advisor) and one member; doctoral committee: chair, vice-chair (advisor) and three members.
The cover and the approval page must each be a single page and must not run onto a second page.
Both files (the final thesis with an unsigned approval page and the signed approval page) must be uploaded before the deadline, or the thesis is not accepted as submitted.
Students who did not submit the preservation thesis last semester, and doctoral students who applied for a review period extension, must use dates within this semester, not last semester.
Approval page signatures already obtained with last semester's date must be obtained again with this semester's date.
After the final approved thesis is submitted, no changes are accepted except correction of obvious typographical errors; a submitted thesis cannot be modified or replaced for any reason.
Affiliation: students admitted up to 2013 use 전기컴퓨터공학부; students admitted from 2014 use 전기·정보공학부 (English: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering).
steps: Read the attachments first: 01 (submission guide), 02 (online submission manual), 03 (thesis writing guide and templates) and 04 (guide to correction submission). Their contents were not read for this translation.
Return any overdue library books and pay any overdue fines, since otherwise the confirmation form cannot be printed.

Prepare the approval page using the template in attachment 03, with submission and approval dates within this semester (example given: submission date July 2026, approval date August 2026), and obtain all committee signatures or seals in advance.
If any committee member signs online, keep the full email exchange with that member and print it as evidence.
Check the degree name, affiliation, author name (foreign students: check English spelling carefully), submission date, approval date and final title in the thesis file.

Upload at dCollection (Central Library homepage > Library Services > Theses > Online Thesis Submission, https://dcollection.snu.ac.kr): (1) one PDF of the final thesis containing an approval page with committee names only, without signatures, and (2) a separate file of the approval page with signatures or seals; agree to the use of the full text.
After uploading, open the file and check that the correct file was uploaded, with no page errors or missing content.
Print the Thesis Submission Confirmation Form from dCollection (see attachment 02, page 17).

Submit to the department office (Building 301, Room 319) between 20 July and 24 July 2026, 17:00: the Thesis Submission Confirmation Form, the original approval page and, if any signature is a copy, the printed evidence for every such committee member.
Finish any final edits on dCollection by 3 August 2026, 23:59 (recommended by 10:00 a.m. that day), and confirm once more that the file uploaded without errors.
translation:
[Graduate School] ★Spring 2026 Final Approved Thesis Submission Guide (Preservation Copy)

The submission of final master's and doctoral theses for students expected to graduate in Spring 2026 is announced as follows. Students concerned must submit within the period.
Submission is complete only when both 1. Submission to the department office and 2. Online submission below are completed.
※ Students who do not submit the Thesis Submission Confirmation Form and the approval page will be excluded from degree conferral.

1. Submission to the department office (Building 301, Room 319)
- Submission period: Monday 20 July 2026 to Friday 24 July 2026, 17:00
* Even after submitting documents to the department office, files uploaded to dCollection can be edited until 3 August.
- Documents to submit
A. Thesis Submission Confirmation Form (학위논문 제출 확인서)
* Check for typos in affiliation, degree name, name, etc.!!: ① From 2014 admission → affiliation: 공과대학 전기·정보공학부 (College of Engineering, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering) ② Degree name: Master's, Doctoral
* Go to http://dcollection.snu.ac.kr, submit the thesis file → print the "Thesis Submission Confirmation Form".
※ How to print the form: see attachment (Attachment 02, Online Thesis Submission Manual → page 17).
* The form cannot be printed if you have unreturned library books or overdue fines, so return the books and pay the fines before printing.
B. Approval page (인준지) (original)
* The approval page may be signed or sealed.
If a signature is a copy, you must submit evidence (such as email) confirming the committee member's intention to approve (evidence is required for every committee member whose signature is a copy).

2. Online thesis submission
- Submission period: Friday 17 July 2026 to Monday 3 August 2026, 23:59
- Method: go to http://dcollection.snu.ac.kr and submit the thesis file. * See attachments (Attachment 01, Attachment 02).
* Where: Central Library homepage > Library Services > Theses > Online Thesis Submission (중앙도서관 홈페이지 > 도서관서비스 > 학위논문 > 학위논문 온라인 제출) (https://dcollection.snu.ac.kr)
* Consent to the use of the full text of the thesis is required. After Monday 3 August, 23:59, correction, replacement and time extension are absolutely impossible. Problems may occur if you edit at the last minute, so complete the submission with time to spare, by 10:00 a.m. that day at the latest.
※ No extension is possible for any reason, including obtaining approval page signatures late or health reasons, so be sure to obtain the signatures in advance.
- Only one full-text PDF file can be uploaded. Total under 100 MB; if image compression is needed, see the online submission manual (Attachment 02).
※ Upload the approval page containing the committee members' signatures as a separate file.
※ For the preservation thesis, no bound copy is submitted to the department office (Room 319); only the full-text file is submitted online to the library.
- After uploading, you must check the full-text file thoroughly so that no wrong file is uploaded and no page errors occur.
Check once again that it is the final file (be sure to check that nothing is missing).
- When submitting, check once more the degree name, affiliation, author name and the submission or approval date (foreign students should take particular care with errors in English spelling).
* Korean: 전기·정보공학부 / English: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
* Admitted up to 2013: 전기컴퓨터공학부 / admitted from 2014: 전기·정보공학부
- When submitting, check the final thesis title.
* The titles must match: MySNU thesis title = approval page title = title in the file uploaded to the library = library thesis title.
If your title changed along the way, you must inform the staff member in charge at the department office (contact in the original notice).
* It may differ from the title in the thesis review result documents (review summary, etc.).

★ (Must read!) How to submit the approval page
1) What is the approval page? The page in the thesis stating "~~ approve this thesis" ("~~ 학위논문을 인준함").
2) How to prepare the approval page
- See attachment (Attachment 03, Thesis writing guide and templates → (kor.) template, thesis writing guide). ※ Example: thesis submission date: July 2026 // thesis approval date: August 2026
- The submission date and approval date must be within this semester. Because approval happens after submission, the approval date must be after the submission deadline. (Using the same submission and approval date is recommended.)
- Master's: chair, vice-chair (advisor), member / Doctoral: chair, vice-chair (advisor), 3 members
- The cover and the approval page must each be submitted as one page and must not run onto two pages. (Important)
3) How to submit the approval page
: Upload the final thesis including an approval page with only the committee members' names, without signatures (or seals), and upload the approval page with the committee members' signatures (or seals) as a separate file.
① Final thesis (approval page without signatures) ② Approval page (with signatures)
That is, two files must each be uploaded, and the thesis is recognised as submitted only if both are uploaded within the deadline.
4) Cautions
- Corrections and replacements are not possible, so check carefully before uploading.
- Examples of typos: wrong degree name, wrong affiliation, wrong author name, wrong submission/approval date, etc.
- If students who did not submit the preservation thesis last semester or (doctoral) students who applied for a review period extension are graduating this semester, the approval date and submission date must be within this semester. Last semester's dates are not allowed.
- The approval page itself is the basis for conferring the degree; even if you already obtained signatures dated last semester, you must obtain them again based on this semester.
5) Electronic signatures
- If one or more committee members signed online:
* Evidence is required for every committee member whose signature is a copy. Without such evidence, a handwritten signature or seal is required.
* When submitting the approval page to the department office, you must also submit the evidence. *Evidence: the entire email exchange with the committee member for the online signature (printed).
- Example 1) Handwritten signatures were obtained first from 3 of 5 committee members, then online signatures from the remaining 2: submit all of documents ①–③ below.
① Original approval page: the approval page with the handwritten signatures
② Approval page: the approval page including all committee members' signatures
③ Evidence
- Example 2) Online signatures were obtained first from 2 of 5 committee members, then handwritten signatures from the remaining 3: submit both documents ①–② below.
① Approval page: the approval page including all committee members' signatures
② Evidence for the 2 online signatures

3. Absolutely no modification, correction or cancellation after the approval page is submitted
- After the final approved thesis is submitted, no corrections can be submitted other than corrections of obvious typographical errors.
* See attachment (Attachment 04: Guide to correction submission of the final approved master's/doctoral thesis (preservation copy)).
* Once submitted, a thesis cannot be modified or replaced for any reason. Supreme Court rulings and similar also strictly prohibit [changes to] the content of a submitted thesis.
- After submission, be sure to check yourself that the full-text file was uploaded without errors.

4. Inquiries
- Online file submission: Central Library, Academic Information Operations Team (contact details in the original notice)
* Inquiries via KakaoTalk: KakaoTalk Plus Friend ID: snuthesis (KakaoTalk > Find Friends (magnifier at top) > ID search)
* Available hours: weekdays 09:00–18:00 (not available on weekends and public holidays)
- Department office document submission: department office (Building 301, Room 319) (contact details in the original notice)

Attachments (4) (their contents were not read for this translation):
1. Thesis submission guide (student guide) Korean/English .zip (127 KB)
2. Online thesis submission manual Korean/English .zip (6 MB)
3. Thesis writing guide and templates .zip (261 KB)
4. Final approved thesis correction submission guide Korean/English .zip (138 KB)
